note: The MVA's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives a new licence, 21 and over, at $88 ($11 a year), non-commercial licences valid for up to 8 years, and a photo ID card at $40, valid up to 8 years from 18 (up to 5 under 18). The full-licence page says a full licence is held from 18, after 18 months on a provisional licence, so it is kept from 18. Not held: the $65 learner's permit that a new driver pays first, proration, the free card from 65.

sources.title: Maryland MVA, License and ID Fees
sources.said: Driver's License New (21 & over) $88*/$11* per year ... Non-commercial driver licenses are valid for a maximum of 8 years ... Photo ID Card New/Renewal $40* ... ID cards for individuals 18 years of age and older will be valid for a period of up to 8 years.

sources.title: Maryland MVA, Full Driver's License
sources.said: You can get a full driver's license if you: Are at least 18 years old Have held your provisional license for at least 18 months
